added.title: Vice President, Product Design
added.description:
Overview

One Inc. is evolving its product organization to be more design-led as we scale our insurance payments platform (ClaimsPay, Premium Pay, Property Pay) and consumer-facing experiences like XpressOne. The Vice President, Product Design will own the design vision, craft standards, and team for the Product organization - leading a design team of ~6+ and growing - while acting as a business-fluent partner to Product and Engineering leadership.

This role is as much about commercial judgment as it is about craft. We need someone who can translate design decisions into business outcomes, own the end-to-end customer journey, and remove friction from our highest-stakes experiences - starting with XpressOne and the broader policyholder payment journey.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end customer journey across Product, with direct accountability for reducing friction in policyholder and carrier-facing experiences
Lead and scale a design organization (UX, UI, design systems, research), currently a team of ~6 product designers, sized appropriately for a Tier 1 fintech/insurtech SaaS company
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed design earlier in the product development lifecycle, with design decisions explicitly tied to business and customer outcomes
Establish and maintain a design system / pattern library that drives consistency and speed across squads
Represent design at the executive level - influence roadmap and prioritization with a business case, not just a craft perspective
Bring external perspective and industry best practices into a team that has largely grown up internally
Build design operating rhythms (critique, research cadence, design reviews) that scale with the org

Qualifications

10+ years in product design, with 5+ years in a design leadership role owning a team and a portfolio
Demonstrated business fluency - able to connect design decisions to revenue, retention, or operational outcomes, and to make that case to non-design executives
Experience in fintech, insurtech, or another high-trust, high-compliance B2B2C environment strongly preferred
Track record building or scaling a design function, including design systems and design ops
Experience owning a customer journey end-to-end, ideally across both consumer-facing (policyholder) and enterprise (carrier/agent) audiences
Strong point of view balanced with collaborative style - able to drive decisions without being prescriptive to the point of stalling teams

Additional Requirements

This position may periodically require work outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends, to support business needs.
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background screening requirements.
One Inc may conduct periodic background checks at any time during employment, as permitted by applicable law and company policy.

Physical Demands

The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Environment

Standard indoor office setting; exposure to computer screens

Remote Work Expected

Physical

Requires repetitive motion. Substantial movements/motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Sufficient mobility to work in an office setting; stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; operate office equipment including use of a computer keyboard, mouse, scanner and other tools as needed

Vision

See in the normal vision range with or without correction; vision sufficient to read computer screens and printed documents

Hearing

Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without corrections

Company Profile:
At One Inc, we empower insurers to meet policyholder expectations with choice, control, convenience, and continuity. Our mission is simple: to make every payment a promise kept.

The One Inc Insurance Payments Network seamlessly integrates multi-channel digital communications with inbound payment processing and outbound disbursement, delivering a frictionless experience for both premiums and claim payments. With over $120 billion in annual payments volume, we are proud to serve more than 300 insurance carriers, helping them honor their commitments instantly and securely.

Headquartered in Folsom, CA, One Inc offers competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits — including medical, dental, and vision insurance — a 401(k) plan, and a strong commitment to work-life balance. We believe in growing from within, promoting opportunities for career advancement across our team of 1,200+ dedicated "Onesters."

Join us in building the infrastructure that fulfills the promise of insurance.

One Inc is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all EEOC legislation in each jurisdiction it operates in.

added.description:
Track record of leading loan origination and new customer onboarding, optimizing approval rates while mitigating fraud and credit risk
Strong analytical and data fluency with experience using business metrics to drive product strategy and prioritization
Experience with different AI tools and techniques to accelerate personal and/or squad productivity
Remote-first opportunity for US-based employees with the option to work in-person out of our Manhattan office

Start your adventure with Zip

We are seeking a collaborative, data-driven Senior Technical Product Manager – Underwriting Platform
to manage lead and scale the technology powering our customer onboarding and underwriting platform. In this role, you will drive platform capabilities to maximize loan approval rates, effectively aligning technical solutions with risk strategies and business goals.

The ideal candidate will manage the roadmap responsible for driving new customer acquisition and activation, optimizing decisioning, and integrating advanced identity and credit data services.

The Product organization at Zip focuses on delivering seamless and innovative financial experiences that support millions of customers. Our teams move quickly, operate with high ownership, and solve complex problems collaboratively. We value a self-starter mindset, curiosity, customer obsession, and strong execution.

Interesting problems you’ll solve

Define and execute platform strategies that drive measurable outcomes across sign-up, loan approvals, and activation while balancing risk.
Partner closely with Engineering, Credit, and Fraud teams to build scalable, compliant, and performant onboarding and lending platform capabilities.
Evaluate and implement AI-enabled product capabilities, workflows, and or automation opportunities that improve customer onboarding experiences and operational efficiency
Collaborate with Engineering and Risk to deliver low-code platform features that accelerate business responsiveness to changing business, risk, and regulatory requirementsenvironmental and compliance landscapes.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

6+ years of Product Management experience, including experience supporting fintech, payments, lending, or financial services platforms
Proven experience owning onboarding, activation, or growth-focused product initiatives with measurable business impact
Strong technical fluency with the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering teams on APIs, platform architecture, and technical tradeoffs
Demonstrated ability to use data, experimentation, and business metrics to inform prioritization and product decisions
Strong understanding of experimentation methodologies including A/B testing, cohort analysis, and growth optimization frameworks
Experience working cross-functionally with Risk, Compliance, Operations, Design, Analytics, and Data Science stakeholders
Familiarity with AI-enabled product capabilities, including the ability to evaluate AI use cases within customer onboarding and growth experiences
Clear alignment with Zip’s core values: Customer First, Own It, Stronger Together, and Change the Game

What You’ll Get In Return

Zip is a place where you’ll get out what you put in. The newness of our sector means we need to move at pace and embrace change, and our promise to you when you join the team is that you’ll feel empowered and trusted to make big things happen quickly.

We want you to feel welcome and as though you have the support to be yourself, and care for yourself at work. Because it’s important to us that you make the most of the opportunities you’ll get to grow your skills and your career, and be surrounded by smart, friendly people and leaders that have your back.

We think these are just some of the best things about being a Zipster. We will also offer you:

Flexible working culture
Incentive programs
Unlimited PTO
Generous paid parental leave
Leading family support policies
Company-sponsored 401k match
Learning and wellness subscription stipend
Beautiful Union Square office with a casual dress code
Industry-leading, employer-sponsored insurance for you and your dependents, with several 100% Zip-covered choices available

Zip is committed to a straightforward and transparent pay structure. The actual base salary will be determined by various individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, location, internal equity, as well as other objective business considerations.

The annual base Pay Range for this position is $133,000 - $165,000. This range reflects our US national compensation band (USN). Additional premium percentages may apply based on our tiered premium strategy.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or commission awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

And finally…get to know us

Zip Co Limited (ASX: ZIP) is a digital financial services company, offering innovative, people-centered products.

Operating in two core markets - Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the US, Zip offers access to point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants.

We’re proud to be a values-led business and our values - Customer First, Own it, Stronger Together and Change the Game - guide us in everything we do.

updated.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood set out to open the financial system to the many, not the few. We've done it for tens of millions of people in the US—now we're taking it global. This is one of the most ambitious initiatives for the company, and you'd be sitting at the center of it.

We're building an elite team that applies frontier technology to the world's biggest financial problems. We want bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency—it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. Expectations are high. So are the rewards.

As a Senior Product Manager for the Crypto Onchain team, you'll be responsible for Robinhood's crypto wallet. You'll work to understand what customers need on their first day, first week and first month and deliver it in a simple, easy-to-understand experience. Whether it's improving our sign-up process or the self-custody experience, you'll be responsible for rolling out the red carpet for every new customer, setting them up for success in their financial lives.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You'll Do

Drive the product roadmap for Robinhood Wallet, evolving the existing experience while defining what’s next—including new products and localized experiences for priority markets
Partner with research, data science, engineering, and design to understand new customers, identify their most pressing needs, and translate insights into product strategy
Build strong, collaborative relationships across design, engineering, operations, and other cross-functional partners to align teams and drive execution at both the team and organizational levels
Lead the launch of intuitive, high-impact products in partnership with communications, content, and marketing teams, ensuring experiences are easy to understand and use

What You Bring

5+ years of experience building and shipping high-quality consumer products
Demonstrated history of using research, experimentation and analytics to guide decision making
Past experience working closely with design and UXR
Extremely curious
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Motivated self-starter
Ability to set high-level strategy + execute with cross-functional teams
Well-versed in the current crypto wallet market
Deep knowledge of onchain culture and products — ideally an active onchain trader
Past experience in fintech or trading
Deep experience with the latest AI tooling such as Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, or ChatGPT.

What We Offer

Market competitive and pay equity-focused compensation structure
100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
Annual lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more!
Lifetime maximum benefit for family forming and fertility benefits
Dedicated mental health support for employees and eligible dependents
Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

updated.title: Senior Global Product Manager
updated.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Mission

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Global Product Manager to lead the development and lifecycle management of CenTrak’s RTLS hardware and firmware solutions. This individual will play a critical role in connecting customer needs, field insights, and business strategy to deliver high impact product outcomes. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and brings a strong ability to translate complex healthcare workflows into scalable, reliable product solutions.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Strategy

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of RTLS hardware and firmware products, ensuring performance, scalability, and clinical reliability

Drive a value-based product roadmap aligned to CenTrak’s strategic priorities and real-world healthcare challenges

Leverage data, VOC, and field feedback to continuously refine priorities and roadmap direction

Backlog & Execution Leadership

Maintain and prioritize a global product backlog focused on customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility

Partner closely with engineering teams to ensure clear requirements, efficient execution, and timely delivery

Voice of Customer & Field Engagement

Lead structured Voice of Customer (VOC) efforts across clinicians, administrators, and operational stakeholders

Engage directly with customers and field teams to understand workflow challenges and operational opportunities

Translate insights into actionable product enhancements and innovations

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with engineering, PMO, supply chain, quality/regulatory, sales, services, and marketing to ensure seamless delivery and adoption

Act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders

Sustainment & Operational Excellence

Lead sustainment strategy to minimize customer disruption and ensure ongoing reliability of deployed solutions

Drive improvements in field performance, issue resolution, and lifecycle efficiency

Market & Innovation

Monitor market trends, competitor landscape, and emerging technologies

Identify opportunities to enhance CenTrak’s RTLS platform capabilities and differentiation

Performance & Impact

Define and track key product performance metrics, including adoption, reliability, and customer satisfaction

Communicate product performance and roadmap progress to leadership

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related technical discipline; advanced degrees or hybrid technical/business backgrounds preferred.

6-8+
years of experience in product ownership or management with a strong emphasis on hardware and firmware development and sustainment, ideally in healthcare environments.

Solid understanding of the healthcare technology landscape; RTLS or MedTech experience is highly desirable.

Proven expertise in Agile methodologies; Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent certification preferred. Ability to work within a Phase Gate process for New Product Development.

Demonstrated ability to lead multi-disciplinary hardware initiatives with a proven record of achieving project milestones.

Experience interfacing with clinical professionals and translating clinical workflows into actionable product requirements.

Ability to conduct product demos and convey solution value to leadership and other stakeholders.

Persuasive communication skills, executive presence, thoughtful stakeholder management, and polished presentation skills with a global, cross-cultural perspective.

Ability to make date informed decisions in ambiguous situations and balance short-term needs with long-term strategy.

Willingness and ability to travel (25- 35%) to customer sites across North America to capture direct feedback and ensure alignment with field realities.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

updated.title: Director - Product Manager
updated.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills And Competencies

Extensive product management experience, typically 10+ years, within financial services, fintech, or risk management software environments
Demonstrated people leadership experience, including at least 3 years managing and developing product managers
Proven ability to lead multiple product squads, manage cross-team dependencies, and balance strategy with execution
Deep understanding of generative AI, large language models, and agentic AI products
Strong command of agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices driven by retrospectives and KPIs
Excellent market analysis, competitive intelligence, and client research capabilities to inform product direction
Data-driven and user-centric approach to product discovery and decision-making
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior and cross-functional partners

Education

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in business, technology, data science, or a related field preferred

Responsibilities

This Director will play a critical leadership role within the GenAI product function, managing a group of 2–3 Product Managers and providing hands-on guidance across their respective squads. Working closely with the Director of GenAI Products, this role helps translate strategic direction into effective squad execution – ensuring teams are well-led, roadmaps are grounded in client and market insight, and delivery runs smoothly across the portfolio.

Lead, mentor, and coach a team of Product Managers to ensure strong execution and professional growth
Set and maintain a high quality bar for product management outputs, including user stories and requirements documentation
Partner with the Director of GenAI Products to contribute to and execute the GenAI product roadmap
Engage with strategy, business partners, and clients to validate priorities and surface new product opportunities
Serve as the primary escalation point for Product Managers, resolving blockers and managing cross-squad dependencies
Establish a consistent operating rhythm across squads, including planning, prioritization, and retrospectives
Define, track, and use product KPIs to guide prioritization and continuous improvement
Drive cross-functional collaboration across technology, design, operations, and strategy teams

About The Team

The Digital Content & Innovation product organization at Moody’s Analytics delivers client-focused digital solutions that enable customers to assess risk and make informed decisions. The GenAI product team builds on Moody’s trusted data, research, and platforms to develop innovative AI-powered capabilities, including agentic solutions and APIs, empowering clients to access and act on Moody’s intelligence in new and impactful ways.

For US-based roles only: the anticipated hiring base salary range for this position is $171,100.00 - $248,050.00, depending on factors such as experience, education, level, skills, and location. This range is based on a full-time position. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for incentive compensation. Moody’s also offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, parental leave, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, a discounted employee stock purchase plan, and tuition reimbursement.
